title: Blinded Edge-Group
summary: The presenting node's entire 'e' section is one bare SAID, computed over an edge-group carrying its own `u`. A viewer cannot tell there are two edges, an OR operator, or anything else -- only that *some* edge-group is committed to.
notes: Blinding at the edge-GROUP level, distinct from compact_private_edge (a single Edge).
name: blinded_edge_group
